question.problem: Let ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14157173/assets/bf51b89da6e28b6f6cf620b709298b81b8c202b54a601741b0bed05cd265b3e9.svg) and ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14157173/assets/39895d1db9365c174ca95dcbd4ba9d374a1c14929859f652e3cfdd07993569ac.svg) Find the scalar projection of $\mathbf{a}$ onto $\mathbf{b}.$
question.worked_solution:
Using the formula for the scalar projection, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{b}\,a & =\frac{a\cdot b}{|\,b\,|} \\  & =\frac{{a}_{x}{b}_{x}+{a}_{y}{b}_{y}+{c}_{z}{b}_{z}}{\sqrt{{b}_{x}^{2}+{b}_{y}^{2}+{b}_{z}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{0\cdot 2+0\cdot (-4)+1\cdot 0}{\sqrt{{2}^{2}+(-4)^{2}+{0}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{0}{\sqrt{{2}^{2}+(-4)^{2}+{0}^{2}}} \\  & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
